rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for presenting something briefly or in summary form.

example.english: To put it summarily, the film is about family.
example.traditional: 簡單嚟講，呢套戲係講親情嘅。
example.jyutping: gaan2 daan1 lai4 gong2 ne1 tou3 hei3 hai6 gong2 can1 cing4 ge3

rows.note: Use this when an action is dealt with hastily or without the usual formalities, as in dismissing someone summarily.

example.english: They dismissed me summarily, without even explaining why.
example.traditional: 佢草草咁打發咗我，連解釋都冇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cou2 cou2 gam3 daa2 faat3 zo2 ngo5 lin4 gaai2 sik1 dou1 mou5

rows.note: Use this when you want to say something in a nutshell, emphasizing extreme brevity rather than abrupt treatment.

example.english: To put it summarily, this plan will not work.
example.traditional: 一句講晒，呢個計劃唔可行。
example.jyutping: jat1 geoi3 gong2 saai3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 ho2 hang4
